description: HTML assertions for PHPUnit and Pest: check rendered HTML with CSS selectors, never as a string.
rules: Check rendered HTML with a CSS selector, never as a string or a regular expression.
Select by tag, role, aria-*, label or text, then by a data-* marker; a class is a value to check with toHaveSelectorClass().
A check of one node needs exactly one match; narrow to a region with within().
Give a check its reason as the last argument; after the optional value of toHaveSelectorAttribute(), pass it by name: message: '…'.
